meta.method: Curated entries (454) are tools I chose as well known for their category; each was checked against the GitHub API on 2026-10-18. Sweep entries come from 139 GitHub topic searches (stars >= 2000, top 100 per topic) and were NOT reviewed by a person. Categories for sweep entries are guessed from the topic that found them. Licence labels use GitHub's detection: only SPDX ids on the OSI-approved list are shown as OSI-approved; "other", "no licence" and anything else means: read the licence yourself (some are source-available, not open source). Stars are a popularity signal, not quality or safety. This is a wide net, not every tool: GitHub-only, English topics, a star floor, and 100 results per topic.
